description: 820k ohm, 1%, 1/4 W metal-film axial resistor, 0207 body

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-11-02: exact match for MFR-25FBF52-820K (YAGEO), Mouser part 603-MFR-25FBF52-820K; Digi-Key Product Information API, same date, lists the same mpn as 13-MFR-25FBF52-820K-ND.
Digi-Key Product Information API, 2026-11-02: Resistance 820 kOhms; Mouser Search API description 'Metal Film Resistors - Through Hole 820K OHM 1/4W 1%'.
Digi-Key Product Information API, 2026-11-02: Tolerance +-1%, Composition Metal Film.
Digi-Key Product Information API, 2026-11-02: Power (Watts) 0.25W, 1/4W; Yageo MFR datasheet CHARACTERISTICS table rates MFR-25 at 1/4W.

Yageo MFR series datasheet, DIMENSIONS table: MFR-25 body L = 6.3 +- 0.5 mm, diameter 2.4 +- 0.2 mm - the DIN 0207 body. Digi-Key Product Information API, 2026-11-02, states Size / Dimension 2.40mm x 6.30mm.
Yageo MFR series datasheet, DIMENSIONS table: MFR-25 body diameter 2.4 +- 0.2 mm.

why: Same Yageo MFR-25FBF52 1% metal-film family as every other axial resistor on this board (docs/parts/sourcing-notes.md Lessons, 2026-09-30), so the board is one family in one 0207 body; in stock at both Mouser and Digi-Key at commodity price. Digi-Key's product number for this value carries a '13-' prefix (13-MFR-25FBF52-820K-ND), unlike the other values; it is the bulk listing.
